title: The Ethiopian Canon: A Study Circle Guide
description: A free seven-session discussion guide for groups reading The Ethiopian Canon: Bible studies, Sunday school classes, book clubs, campus fellowships and families. Each 75-minute session follows the same rhythm (Open, Read aloud, Talk, Carry, This week) and comes with leader notes. Includes the circle's promises, a thirteen-week option for a Sunday school quarter, and "Questions We Are Keeping." 44 pages, PDF. Free to copy and share for non-commercial study.
